tochegando.title: Tô Chegando Bar & Restaurant
tochegando.problem: Bookings arrived by phone and got lost at peak hours. The floor plan was also hardcoded: the 26 tables came from a migration with coordinates calibrated by hand, so rearranging the room for a barbecue or a live show meant calling a developer.
tochegando.solution: A complete website with online bookings, login and an admin panel — plus a visual floor plan editor in the vein of SevenRooms and OpenTable: the staff lays out the room by dragging tables over a photo of the venue, and guests book on that same plan, in real time. Nobody needs a developer to rearrange the room anymore. Under the hood: percentage-based geometry so the plan scales from phone to monitor with no table drifting, dragging via Pointer Events with no new library, batched saving through a single RPC, writes restricted to staff by SECURITY DEFINER functions, and deletion that preserves history — a booking from last month still reads Table 26 even with a new Table 26 on the floor. 92 unit tests.
tochegando.imageAlt: Home page of the Tô Chegando Bar & Restaurant website

thaystop.title: Thays Miranda — Vehicle Protection
thaystop.client: Top Brasil · Vila Velha and Greater Vitória, Brazil
thaystop.problem: A vehicle protection consultant needed a page that explained the coverage and took interested visitors straight into a conversation, with no form in the middle cooling the lead down.
thaystop.solution: A single-page landing site with the coverage options, a quote simulator, social proof and the consultant's profile. Every button opens her WhatsApp with the message already written — each extra form field is one more person who gives up. Built in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with no framework: for a single page a bundler never pays for itself, and without one the page loads faster.
thaystop.imageAlt: Home page of Thays Miranda's vehicle protection landing page
